neighbours.label: habitual frequency words: constantly, always, never, keeps (a repeated or unchanging behaviour)
fire: My brother is constantly a surprise to everyone at work.
When you press the button it always opens the wrong window.
Our dog never wants to walk past the bakery.
That printer keeps jamming whenever we need it most.
I think she is constantly worried about the rent.
The bus always arrives ten minutes after the bell.
My uncle never seems to finish his stories.
Every neighbor keeps asking about the broken fence.
quiet: My brother is a surprise guest at the party at work.
When you press the button it opens the blue window.
Our dog wants to walk past the bakery this morning.
That printer jammed yesterday when we needed it most.
I think she is worried about the rent this month.
The bus arrived ten minutes after the bell today.
My uncle seems to enjoy his stories about the sea.
One neighbor asked about the broken fence last night.
